I'm to break any one of the three.

- I told Never-Sold that Rows-For-Another has gone by the channel. Brings-Them-Back is dead, so nobody can follow her home, and her Owing will be written onto the keeper. Third-Born Tsaxi: "You come from the north house. I know the Broker's children when I see them, and I say that once and no more. I will not explain it. Ask the woman who sent you. A fire went through the upper floors of the Rose. The heirs sent three of their held up to me, to keep until the Rose's leaves came after them. The leaves are the pages that say what each person is held for. I cannot read them, so a reckoner was to carry them and read them out. A reckoner is the one who reads the Rose's leaves and keeps its count. The three are a young man, a young woman and an old woman. The old woman is held for a roof: she owes the heirs for the shelter they gave her. One of the two young ones is held for words said in the yard. The other is held for a killing, and when the leaf is read that one will be put under. To be put under is to be sent down below the Rose, past the gate, where the dead still walk. Nobody comes up. Which of the two young ones is which, I do not know. Both say they are the one held for words. Both can say the words. I counted them into this house, and I did not count what their hands had done. Hear what I can do. I can lose one of the three to the smoke, and the heirs will believe it, because people die in fires. I cannot lose two. Two is a hunt, and the hunt ends at my neck. So only one can leave this house, and it is for you to say which. The reckoner came north by the wet road round the west of the lake. He had four with him, and none came back. His camp is the swamp tent, far west of the town, round the lake by the wet road, past the reeds. I do not say what is in that swamp. I say five men went into it and none came back, so go armed or do not go. If you find his leaves, read them before you choose. I cannot, and no one here can."
Objective completed: Speak to Third-Born Tsaxi, keeper of the heirs' post on Blackrose's east shore.
Journal entry (One Out of the Smoke): Tsaxi can count one of the three lost to the Rose's fire, and no more. Walks-Far and Mends-Nets each claim to be held for words; one killed a man. The leaves that say which are with the Rose's reckoner, lost in the western swamp. I'm to learn who is who, and read the leaves if I find them.
New objective: Learn which of the two killed: bring back the reckoner's leaves from his camp in the western swamp, or win the truth from Seven-Floods. Or pay Tsaxi to count one lost without knowing which.
